preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have exactly m columns.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'X', 'O'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must be either 'X' or 'O'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of total X shapes as a string.
The count of X shapes must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: count == sum(1 for row in grid for cell in row if cell == 'X') // (1 + any(cell == 'X' for cell in row))
postconditions.description: The count of X shapes must match the number of connected 'X' groups.
